# eIDAS (Regulation (EU) No 910/2014 as amended by 2024/1183): qualified electronic ledgers and qualified electronic time stamps: clause → mechanism → status

This table maps clauses to SecuraCV mechanisms. It is not a determination: a supervisory body, and the courts decides whether a deployment's records and controls are acceptable. The receipt ledgers are the record; this table points at them. Status words: [STATUS.md](STATUS.md). The frame: [README.md](README.md).

Source: Regulation (EU) No 910/2014 as amended by Regulation (EU) 2024/1183 — not fetched (blocked); requirement text is our paraphrase and every clause marked † is unverified: eur-lex.europa.eu and etsi.org were unreachable when this map was written; article content follows docs/security/PROVENANCE_INTEROP.md §1.1 and is unverified; no sub-paragraph letters are used; requirement text is our paraphrase
